newsitem.title: USA: Ballard buys 90 pct of Cardiotronics.
newsitem.headline: Ballard buys 90 pct of Cardiotronics.

text.p: Cardiotronics Systems Inc said Tuesday that Ballard Medical Products Inc bought 90.177 percent of the outstanding shares of capital stock of Cardiotronics in a private stock purchase transaction.

Ballard, through its unit Ballard Acquisition Corp, bought all of the preferred and common stock holdings of certain venture capitalists and other individuals for $3.75 per share of common stock and paid off about $2.7 million in debt owed by the company to the venture capitalists.
As part of the deal Cardiotronics' outstanding line of credit has been paid and certain officers and employees have received retention bonus payments and option payoffs.
